notes.title: SCP STRATEGY - Update 1.7
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi SCP players![/h1]
We are back with a new update! Do you want to know what is new?

First of all, we have reached the amount of 500 SCPs available in the game!
We have also decided to add a new visual upgrade to SCP Strategy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/3b47803496cbe31b42e3dcc56a2bca32055c8306.png[/img]

[h3]SCPs added in [b]v1.7[/b] :[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]SCP- 634[/b] - Goldfish with memory-weakening effects
[*] [b]SCP- 636[/b] - Maintenance elevator with special access to a sub-basement
[*] [b]SCP- 637[/b] - Psychic organism residing in an elderly woman's brain, manifesting as a cat
[*] [b]SCP- 639[/b] - Caucasian male observed from all angles simultaneously, inducing paranoia and headaches in observers
[*] [b]SCP- 640[/b] - Sentient electromagnetic phenomenon manifesting as yellow-orange light spots
[*] [b]SCP- 641[/b] - Unusually thin Russian matryoshka dolls with anomalous properties
[*] [b]SCP- 643[/b] - Collection of chocolate candies with assimilative properties when melted
[*] [b]SCP- 644[/b] - Italian man known as "Mr. Hot," with the ability to detect if someone has children and comprehend children's wishes
[*] [b]SCP- 645[/b] - Marble disk with a humanoid face, similar to the Bocca della Verità carving
[*] [b]SCP- 646[/b] - Grey gelatinous creature that gives birth to non-anomalous species
[*] [b]SCP- 647[/b] - Cardboard box that morphs to fit anyone nearby and consumes them
[*] [b]SCP- 649[/b] - Matchbox with anomalous cold and snow-producing properties when opened or a match is struck
[*] [b]SCP- 650[/b] - Black mannequin that follows people when not observed, assumes threatening poses but is harmless
[*] [b]SCP- 651[/b] - Highly contagious virus causing fusion of human soft tissues
[*] [b]SCP- 653[/b] - Multi-colored plastic boomerang causing obsession and location awareness in those who touch it
[*] [b]SCP- 654[/b] - Male narwhal with a uniquely clockwise-grown tusk
[*] [b]SCP- 655[/b] - Windowless structure in the Democratic Republic of Congo that irregularly creates animal-like beings
[*] [b]SCP- 657[/b] - Elegantly-dressed man who can predict the exact date of a person's death
[*] [b]SCP- 658[/b] - Autonomous robotic devices with spider-like legs and a unique upper half in each specimen
[*] [b]SCP- 660[/b] - Irregular earthenware urn with an interior coated in mammalian uterine tissue
[/list]
[b]You can join our [url=https://discord.gg/KBx4kzJ]discord[/url].[/b]

[h3]We also remind you about the upcoming beta tests of SCP: The Expedition! Will you join a new amazing adventure?[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2329910/SCP_The_Expedition/?utm_source=scps_steam

notes.title: SCP STRATEGY - Update 0.6
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi SCP players![/h1]

We are back with a new update! Do you want to know what is new?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/552c88ae9868cda38a3cee07cb36b91b05cf42ee.png[/img]

[h2]Anomalies Market![/h2]

Now you can trade objects. Unlock proper skills and the Anomalies Market will be available in the Scientific Department.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/d28f40c850e4508e29ab300a7ffc67c07d821129.jpg[/img]

[h2]Redesigned Scientific Department![/h2]

Now Scientific Department will let you sell your objects. The details section has been a little bit redesigned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/53b8a3709ec0b3eff6df4e29e8a85ec8d3ab7f29.jpg[/img]

[h2]Improved Battles![/h2]

Now you can inflict critical damage to your enemies.  That makes battles more unpredictable. Moreover, after a few battles, you can completely destroy hostile organizations. Now, relationships between organizations will now be better simulated. That means their power will be changed every month.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/a05e0d5565ad17cb8bee5040fdae1db167fa3a56.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Skills![/h2]

Unlock new skills to increase the chances of your spies, get access to the Anomalies Market and inflict critical hits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/865c8ea5bb91aa3f6047cd2911bfb3dbdee8beb0.jpg[/img]


[h2][b]v0.6[/b] full changelog:[/h2]
[list]
[*] redesigned Scientific Department
[*] added Anomalies Market
[*] added 22 new SCP objects
[*] added new skills
[*] added GOIs power's system [i]( now you can destroy every organization )[/i]
[*] added new buttons in the pause menu [i]( how to play, report bug )[/i]
[*] added new tutorials
[*] reorganize skills in Engineering Department
[*] improved battles system  [i]( critical hits )[/i]
[*] improved finding new anomalies  [i]( it will be easier to find objects added from mods )[/i]
[*] improved statistics system
[*] improved spying other organizations
[*] improved game save files
[*] improved optimization
[*] improved credits' screen
[*] changed chance to win after using  [i]Commander +++[/i] skill
[*] fixed relations system
[*] fixed loading icons in mods editor
[*] fixed some typos
[*] fixed generating names for new objects
[*] fixed showing short descriptions of objects when language was not set to English 
[/list]

[b]If you want to help us with the translation process visit [url=https://www.localizor.com/scp-strategy]localizor.com/scp-strategy[/url].[/b]

[i]Let us know if you will find any new bugs or issues. [/i]

notes.title: SCP STRATEGY - Update 0.4
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi SCP players![/h1]

We are back with a new update! Do you want to know what is new?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/552c88ae9868cda38a3cee07cb36b91b05cf42ee.png[/img]

[h2]The new Intelligence Agency screen![/h2]

Now you can find there other groups of interest. You can spy on them and then attack to gain some profits. This panel will also show you what organizations could be dangerous and learn more about their combat abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/e2abde53b950178b448f8ab4245b991355029eac.png[/img]

[h2]Organizations edtor![/h2]

Now you can create and share also new organizations. The new editor will let you the ability to create dreamed-up opponents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/a4e81ae6d2f34f140b172027efa7ccd1c99add5a.jpg[/img]

[h2]Redesigned Internal Department![/h2]

Now Internal Department will let you manage all of your sites and MTFs easier in one place!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/1878877af821bed786698db65a00a16bfd9739da.png[/img]

[h2]Toggling borders![/h2]

Click the globe's icon on the top right corner to enable or disable borders. You can switch between three modes. The first one will show only coastlines,  the second one will show you countries' borders, and the last one will show you provinces.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/57ca64c427d0780dd253f559a7fe5fcc80b36896.jpg[/img]


[h2][b]v0.4[/b] full changelog:[/h2]
[list]
[*] redesigned Internal Department's screen [i]( now it contains sites' and mtfs' view)[/i]
[*] redesigned Intelligence Agency's screen [i]( now it shows other groups of interest )[/i]
[*] added spying and attacking other organizations
[*] added organizations' editor to the modding tools [i]( Steam Workshop is supported! )[/i]
[*] added toggling borders on the globe
[*] added separate volume settings for combat sounds
[*] balanced battles [i]( the player will be attacked less often after losses)[/i]
[*] fixed sounds and music on the main menu
[*] fixed showing unadded languages in the settings panel
[*] improved save files [i]( the first run of v0.4 may reset your volume settings! )[/i]
[*] improved optimization
[/list]


[i]Let us know if you will find any new bugs or issues. [/i]
